profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Versaterm eJust Systems
profile.summary:
Masters graduate in Computer Science from South Dakota State University.

• 3+ year experience in C++ software development.
• Solid background in Computer Science fundamentals(Data structure, Algorithms, Security)
• Strong Programing Skills using C++, C, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Cold Fusion, C#, Java, ASP.NET.
• Develop and manage software using agile system development life cycle.
• Good communication skills.
• Self-starter and enjoy working in a team with other passionate colleagues. 
• Creative, self-motivated and ambitious.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:

•Application helped streamline borrowing and lending of money between different citi branches 
 worldwide
•Resolved critical same-day issues effectively in a timely manner.

positions.title: Mom
positions.description: Took a break focusing to care for my new born baby. Having achieved that milestone, I am now eager to re-enter workforce and start focusing on my career.

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description:
Design, develop and test applications for SDSU.
Successfully developed payment application in ColdFusion used for college events. 
Developed map application for buildings in college campus using JavaScript and CSS.
Developed game console request application using C# and ASP.NET.
Participate in client meetings for requirements gathering.
Bug fixing and enhancement of existing projects.
Experience in agile software development process.

projects.title: Evacuation Planner (Master Thesis)
projects.description:
• Designed an evacuation routing algorithm, Forward Backward Shortest Path (FBSP). 
• Developed the algorithm in C++. Implementation used various data structures.
• FBSP has shorter evacuation time than existing algorithms like SMP and CCRP++.
• Experimental analysis comparing evacuation and execution times for up to one million evacuees.

projects.title: Class Room Search Application
projects.description:
• Developed room search application that allow to view university classroom.
• Developed an Interactive map to display room location.
• Build the application using JavaScript, CSS, HTML, jQuery, ColdFusion and SQL.

publications.title: Accurate evacuation route planning using forward-backward shortest paths
